details: The European Commission has proposed its 22nd package of sanctions against Russia, aiming to further curb its ability to finance the war in Ukraine. The measures include targeting dozens of Russian banks, imposing restrictions on crypto platforms, and introducing bans on Russian sporting teams and athletes. A new crypto sanctions task force will be launched to prevent circumvention through crypto assets, and the transaction ban will extend to approximately 60 Russian banks, disconnecting them from the SWIFT international payment system.
title: EU Proposes New Sanctions Targeting Russian Banks and Crypto

details: Global financial markets, including cryptocurrencies, are showing signs of recovery as the U.S. dollar retreats from recent highs, fostering a broader risk-on sentiment among investors. This positive shift is also benefiting equities, precious metals, and oil. Geopolitical risks in the Middle East, particularly recent attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure, are contributing to a rebound in crude oil prices.
title: Global Markets Rebound Amid Dollar Weakness; Geopolitics Boost Oil
